title: Korea bio firms tap beauty to fund drugs and seize US, Europe sales channels - Chosunbiz
text:
Korea bio firms tap beauty to fund drugs and seize US, Europe sales channels - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 10월 31일(토) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Science Korea bio firms tap beauty to fund drugs and seize US, Europe sales channels 
 Korean biotech pivots to beauty for steady cash while building direct US and Europe sales networks 
 입력 2026.10.30. 06:36 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 More Korean bio corporations are expanding their beauty and aesthetics businesses to secure the cash needed for new drug development and speed up entry into overseas markets. They are acquiring local distributors or securing production bases to build overseas sales networks directly. The strategy is to establish a stable revenue source through the beauty business while building a sales base in foreign markets.
 On the 30th, according to the pharmaceutical and biotech industry, Korean bio corporations are changing their overseas business structures by acquiring foreign distributors, securing local production facilities, and shifting to direct sales. They are moving away from relying on existing distributors to directly manage sales channels and improve profitability.
 ChatGPT ◇Beauty funds new drugs… Shaperon and Genome & Company acquire overseas distributors 
 The immune and inflammatory disease new drug developer Shaperon(378800) in July acquired 60% equity in the home beauty and healthcare corporations NeedsTech, pushing to expand its beauty business. The strategy is to use the sales base of its existing beauty business to raise funds needed for new drug development and to broaden sales channels to overseas markets.
 NeedsTech sells diet devices, beauty devices, and massagers under the "Hugrabb" brand. It recently established local subsidiaries in Singapore and Australia and launched on Amazon in the United States and Japan, while its Hong Kong subsidiary surpassed cumulative sales of 1 billion won just three months after its establishment. Shaperon aims to achieve more than 10 billion won in overseas sales by 2027 based on this.
 Shaperon also launched its own beauty brand "Dr. Shaun" in Nov. last year. It applied "LumiRua," an ingredient developed with a focus on chronic microinflammation (inflammaging) related to skin aging. It plans to expand GPCR19-based inflammation control technology secured during new drug research into functional cosmetics and beauty devices.
 New drug development expenses and financial burdens are also behind the push to grow the beauty business. Shaperon listed on the KOSDAQ market in 2023 through a technical exception, and the grace period for designation as an administrative issue due to loss from continuing operations before income tax expense (pre-tax loss) has ended. The pre-tax loss ratios were 93.14% in 2024 and 62.75% in 2025. If the ratio is not reduced below 50% this year, there is a risk of being designated as an administrative issue.
 Shaperon is currently developing the Alzheimer's treatment "Nucerin," the immuno-oncology therapy "Papiliximab," and the atopic dermatitis treatment "Nugel," which is in a U.S. phase 2b clinical trial. Given the heavy expense burden of Nugel's clinical development, it plans to pursue technology out-licensing.
 Genome & Company(314130) , which recently expanded its new drug development strategy from the existing microbiome to antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), is also growing its beauty business as a key revenue source. Through its 100% subsidiary Bloom Partners, it acquired 64.46% equity in All Bloom, a U.S. exporter and distributor of Korean beauty brands, securing management control. The goal is to expand entry into the U.S. market for its cosmetics brand "UIQ (UIQ)."
 All Bloom is building distribution networks with major U.S. retailers such as Target and MINISO. Genome & Company plans to use All Bloom's local distribution network to increase overseas sales of UIQ. Last year, UIQ sales were about 12 billion won, up 50% from the previous year.
 ◇From local production to distribution networks… directly securing overseas sales channels 
 Aesthetics corporations with a high proportion of overseas sales are also changing their local sales structures.
 Hugel(145020) is shifting to a direct sales system to expand the U.S. market for its main products, botulinum toxin and fillers. It is converting existing local distributors to a contract sales organization (CSO) model and repurchasing inventory previously supplied to distributors. The strategy is to move beyond handing products to distributors to directly managing local sales and simplifying the distribution structure.
 PharmaResearch(214450) in June acquired U.S. cosmetics manufacturer CG USA, securing a local production base. CG USA has facilities registered with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and infrastructure to produce over-the-counter (OTC) products. PharmaResearch, which had been exporting "Rejuran Cosmetic" produced in Korea to the United States, plans to use the local production and logistics system through this acquisition to expand into Canada, Latin America, and other overseas markets.
 There are also cases of using existing overseas distribution networks to sell cosmetics. Celltrion(068270) plans to use the distribution network of the French healthcare corporation Gifrer, acquired in May, to sell products from group affiliates. Gifrer has a supply network covering about 9,000 pharmacies and 800 hospitals across France.
 Celltrion Group affiliate Celltrion Skincure plans to launch the dermacosmetic brand "Zipiderm" in the French pharmacy cosmetics market early next year. Gifrer will handle local sales and distribution, and Celltrion's French subsidiary plans to leverage the medical network built through sales of biopharmaceuticals such as "Yuflyma" and "OMLYCLO."
 A biotech industry official said, "To enter major distribution channels like Sephora in the United States or Olive Young, you need not only product competitiveness but also local distribution networks and sales capabilities," adding, "If you acquire an overseas distributor or build a local sales organization, you can directly handle everything from entry negotiations to marketing and inventory management, which is advantageous for growing a brand."
